scope: The 544 morphologically licensed tokens in the 559-token opredě-family; fifteen malformed surfaces were explicitly denied and reserved for sentence repair.
choice: Normalize the licensed family from opredě-/neopredě- to official oprědě-/neoprědě-, preserving every other byte, inflection, and semantic role.
motivation: Official headwords consistently use oprěděl-. The clean 544-token tranche differs only by the missing rě sequence and spans define, determine, definite, and indeterminate senses; a semantic lemma switch would lose those distinctions.
alternatives_rejected: Blindly accent all 559 tokens would canonize fifteen malformed endings and conjugations.
Global definiovati would erase determine/fixed/indeterminate meanings.
Retaining a zero-headword opreděl- family leaves a systemic orthographic inconsistency.

denylist.finding: Every malformed type was excluded by exact whole-token denylist for the following sentence-aware edit.

validation.coverage: 544 licensed sites changed; exact fifteen-token denylist preserved
validation.structure: TeX controls, references, braces, math delimiters, protected fragments, and line counts unchanged
validation.reproducibility: Frozen hashes reproduced before atomic apply
